Stage 2 · Java foundations

Comments & Readable Code

Code says WHAT; comments say WHY. Future-you debugs at midnight — be kind.

⏱ 10 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Painting plus plaque

Plaque the why, never every brushstroke.

🖼️

Museum plaque. The painting (code) shows; the plaque (comment) explains why it matters. But plaques never repaint — stale comments that contradict code mislead worse than silence.

Main.java
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    // WHY 18? It is the legal adult age in our town.
    int adultAge = 18;
    /* Prices below include tax.
       Change TAX_RATE in one place only. */
    System.out.println("Adult at " + adultAge);
  }
}
// one line, /* */ many, /** */ documentation. Compiler strips all three before running.
